# Pin how the RPC API manager resolves each call's type and URL

## Welcome 👋

`Neo.manager.rpc.Api` reads a remote API description (services, their methods and streams) and registers one entry per call. Each entry resolves its `type` and `url` from the most specific level that sets one, falling back to a default. It is a short, pure method with no test yet: a table of inputs and outputs, and nothing to mock.

This is a **good first issue** for Hacktoberfest 2026. It needs Node.js and a clone of this repository: no Docker, no AI setup.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Reserved for first-time Neo.mjs contributors.** The maintainer team will not claim, edit, or implement this issue through **2026-10-31**. Comment here to claim it, and ask anything on this issue.

**Set up once:** follow [Set up the engine from a clone](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/dev/CONTRIBUTING.md#set-up-the-engine-from-a-clone), including `npm run bundle-browser-deps`: without it the unit suite selects zero tests.

## Where things live

- Source: `src/manager/rpc/Api.mjs`, the singleton `Neo.manager.rpc.Api` with `registerApi(api)`. Read an entry back with `Api.get('Service.method')`.
- New test file: `test/playwright/unit/manager/rpc/Api.spec.mjs`
- Pattern to copy: `test/playwright/unit/util/Array.spec.mjs` (the `setup()` call and imports)
- Tip: the singleton has no reset, so give every test its own service names (e.g. `TestUsers1`). An API description looks like `{url, type, services: {Users: {url, type, methods: {read: {}}, streams: {feed: {}}}}}`.

## What to cover

Register `{url: 'https://api.test/', type: 'ajax', services: {Users: {url: 'https://users.test/', methods: {read: {}, create: {type: 'websocket'}, destroy: {url: 'https://x.test/'}}, streams: {feed: {}}}, Tasks: {type: 'websocket', methods: {list: {}}, streams: {live: {type: 'sse'}}}}}`, then:

| Entry | Expected |
|---|---|
| `Users.read` | `type: 'ajax'` (the API's), `url: 'https://users.test/'` (the service's), `method: 'read'`, `service: 'Users'` |
| `Users.create` | `type: 'websocket'`: the method's own type wins |
| `Users.destroy` | `url: 'https://x.test/'`: the method's own url wins |
| `Tasks.list` | `type: 'websocket'` (the service's), `url: 'https://api.test/'` (the API's) |
| `Tasks.live` | `type: 'sse'`, `isStream: true` |
| `Users.feed` | `type: 'ajax'`, `isStream: true`. A stream without its own type takes the API's `ajax` before its `websocket` default. Pin it as it is, and if you think a stream should not inherit `ajax`, say so on this issue. |

Then register `{services: {Bare: {methods: {ping: {}}, streams: {tick: {}}}}}` (no API-level `type` or `url`):

| Entry | Expected |
|---|---|
| `Bare.ping` | `type: 'ajax'` (the method default), `url` undefined |
| `Bare.tick` | `type: 'websocket'` (the stream default), `isStream: true` |

## Done when

- [ ] `test/playwright/unit/manager/rpc/Api.spec.mjs` exists, following the pattern file's setup.
- [ ] One `test(...)` per table row.
- [ ] Test-only: if the class disagrees with a row, say so on this issue before changing `src/`.
- [ ] `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/manager/rpc/Api.spec.mjs` passes.
- [ ] `npm run test-unit` passes.

## Out of scope

Calling a registered method over the network, and the parsers, normalizers and pipelines an entry can name.

## While you wait for review

You just pinned one small piece of a multi-threaded application engine: in Neo.mjs your app's code runs inside a web worker, and the main thread only paints. Two things worth ten minutes:

- **See the part nobody expects.** Run `npm run build-themes -- -n -e dev -t all` and `npm run server-start`, open `apps/workstation/`, and drag a tab out of the browser window. It becomes its own OS window, still running, with the same component instances and the same worker. [Benefits: Introduction](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/dev/learn/benefits/Introduction.md) explains why that is possible.
- **Your coding agent can go much further here.** The skills this repository's AI maintainers work with are published on npm as [`neo-agent-skills`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/neo-agent-skills), and they need no Knowledge Base and no Memory Core. With Claude or GPT beside you, the `help wanted` issues are within reach after this one.
